stem:
Wafa must make an exact copy of $\angle DEF$ at a new vertex $U$ on a fresh ray.

Which construction copies the angle?

options.text: Naming the new vertex $U$ completes the copy.
Any arc centred at $U$ copies $\angle DEF$.
From $E$ and from $U$ draw arcs of the same radius; then transfer the chord between the arc hits on $\angle DEF$ onto the new arc.
The matching arc and chord rebuild $\angle DEF$ at $E$ rather than a copy at $U$.

teacher.key_rationale: Copying an angle needs matching arcs from the old and new vertices and a transferred chord length onto the new arc. Naming the vertex, drawing any arc, or rebuilding the angle at the source vertex all miss that transfer.
